FIELD_AND_COPY_RULE: Authority identities, environment/resource provenance and capture framing are included within these publication classes. If an additional standalone reference/copy/artifact is produced, its complete charge/cardinality must be added, not silently excluded.
OS_INTERNAL_BOOKKEEPING_RULE: Original86 permits system-manager transient/cgroup/private-tmp/telemetry bookkeeping. Those internal OS effects are not observer evidence publication; actual observer exports/copies from them count in the same publication allocation. This creates no unbounded OS-resource exemption or permission: separately verified host/workload controls remain mandatory. Full H77/inert-campaign cumulative-write requirements are not amended by this metadata-specific rule.
